blocks.text: About 360 children and adults joined forces to tow a roughly 133-ton Boeing 787 aircraft decorated with Pokemon characters at Narita airport near Tokyo, moving it about 80 meters in an event to spur interest in aviation. A 100-meter rope was attached to the 62.8-meter-long jet so the participants could pull it on the premises of one of Japan’s busiest international airports. READ: Pokemon theme park opens in Tokyo The All Nippon Airways aircraft slowly moved as participants chanted and pulled together.
